_comment: The fleet registry. Device identity lives here, not in code. A web UI reads this to render the device list before any MQTT message arrives. Hardware-to-device mapping is inferred from what each script drives and has NOT been confirmed against the physical Pis - verify before relying on it.

fan-01._credentials_note: Deliberately sys2, not sys3. This records existing behaviour: the fan node has always connected with sys2's certificate. Recorded as data rather than hidden in a call.

camera-01._provisioned_note: Has never connected. No secrets/sys4/ directory exists; this node needs its own AWS IoT thing and certificate.
